reviews.review:
What an extremely pleasant surprise!

For a pretty unknown early access indie game, this has got to be one of the best fast paced shooters I have played that also has a healthy dosing of the rouge-like genre sprinkled on top that easily scratches the itch I get for games like doom and risk of rain.

The maps are very accommodating for the fast paced gameplay, with plenty of platforms to hop onto and rails to slide around and help keep up the pace.

The gunplay in this game is very well done, as all the weapons feel great to use and there are plenty to select from as you advance a run and loot chests. From your standard double barrel shotguns and laser rifles, to chainsaws, mine layers and a flak cannon that is very reminiscent; this game has them all. Add on top the random modifiers that will appear on weapons and you will be hard pressed to find the exact same one twice.

Whilst the fps part is the main focus, the rouge-like part still has a good presence. There are currently four classes (with another one coming in the future) in the game that each have a different passive, ability and melee/ranged attack. As you level up, you will be presented with perks you can unlock that are unique to each class (alongside some generic ones) which can sometimes unlock further additions to previously unlocked perks in a run. Chests and shops will sometimes also offer modifiers that alongside the previously mentioned perks and weapons can create some fun synergies that make you a powerhouse like in any rouge-like. There are also permanent upgrades you can unlock for future runs.

 The only downside I can think of for the moment is that the game is currently in early access; which can understandably cause some hesitancy. If that is the case however, I definitely think that you should wishlist the game/note it down as it is very promising. Some other reviews have mentioned crashes/poor optimisation but I have been fortunate and have had no issues.

Highly recommend; this game needs more attention from the public!

Edit: Just wanted to also add that the game has a nice aesthetic and an awesome soundtrack!
Fix the constant freezing and crashing. Playing a run for an hour just for the game to crash on the final boss is an easy way to get someone like myself to permanently cease playing.
A really really good fps rouge like game!!!!

Definitely a very underrated and unappreciated game. This is an absolute must buy seeing the direction of the game. Every big update introduces something new and it scratches the itch of a fast paced fps roguelite.
